sequences.note: Every identifier is a UUID; there are no sequences in schema public, so no existing-sequence cleanup was needed. Future sequences are covered by the normalized postgres default (proven in browser-default-privileges.local.test.ts).

function_default_limitation: Measured on PostgreSQL 17.6: no ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES form suppresses the built-in EXECUTE TO PUBLIC on a new function. The durable control is schema-authority-contract.local.test.ts, which fails if any VOLATILE non-trigger function in public is anon/PUBLIC reachable.
postgrest_upsert_rule: PostgREST checks the TABLE privilege before resolving columns, so .upsert() needs table-level INSERT+UPDATE+SELECT. Column-scoped UPDATE breaks it with 403 42501 even when every written column is granted. Measured, not assumed. Column scoping is therefore used only for plain-UPDATE paths (profiles) and INSERT-only paths.
shorthand_property_trap: support_tickets passes `subject` as an ES shorthand property, which a `name:` regex misses. Read the caller, do not pattern-match the payload.
